name: University of Tokyo
header:
University of Tokyo
Japan · Graduate School of Mathematical Sciences: master’s, then doctoral program; overseas special selection and regular
selection
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• This is the Graduate School of Mathematical Sciences, not the separate School of Science GSGC.
• April intake and closed 2027 deadlines make a June 2027 bachelor’s graduation a significant obstacle; do not
extrapolate deadlines.
• No guaranteed stipend established; scholarships require separate competitive selection.
• FoPM funding selection does not reopen the closed April 2027 mathematics entrance round. Verify
degree-completion and enrollment timing before investing in scholarship essays.
• Central MEXT instructions ask embassy applicants to contact UTokyo only after primary screening via official
contact points; Mathematics liaison expressly accepts earlier special-selection applications. Clarify the
distinction with the liaison, not unsolicited faculty outreach.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
A UChicago bachelor’s normally qualifies for master’s study, not automatic direct doctoral entry. Regular April
2027 applicants must finish by 31 March 2027; a June 2027 conferral misses that intake. Overseas special
selection is for applicants living outside Japan. US F-1 is not Japanese student status; nationality and
graduation date remain essential checks. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Choose regular versus overseas special selection; do not combine them for one academic year. For special
selection request the nonpublic form from liaison@ms.u-tokyo.ac.jp and identify desired supervisors. Regular
2027 faculty enquiries were restricted to before the application period: by 29 June 2026. Normal bachelor’s
eligibility does not require the special equivalency-review route. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Overseas special form names potential supervisors. For the closed regular 2027 round, faculty admissions
enquiries were allowed only through 29 June 2026. Ask liaison about future routes before approaching faculty.
Kavli IPMU advisers involve the Kashiwa affiliation and relevant supervision arrangement. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Regular route online PDF uploads; instructions and questionnaire publicly available, form preview partly
unreadable in text extraction. Special selection is document/postal plus online examination, form by liaison
request; do not assume a US-style application portal. [s1] [s2] [s5]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
April 2027 regular round is closed. Standing overseas-special September deadline has also passed for 2027 as
interpreted from the school’s rule. October entry is exceptional, particularly government scholarship routes; no
fresh 2027 late-opening window verified. June 2027 UChicago graduation is incompatible with April 2027
matriculation. [s1] [s2] [s3]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Regular April 2027: 30 June 2026 10:00-7 July 2026 15:00, now closed (Japan local time inferred from Japanese
instructions). Overseas special route: postal submission by 30 September preceding enrollment year under
standing guidance, hence 30 September 2026 for 2027 as an inference; that date has passed. Ask liaison
whether any later/October 2027 route remains; none verified. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Funding consideration [Conflict]
Tokyo Math’s 2027 embassy-MEXT school deadline was 27 July 2026, earlier than the central MEXT 1
September 2026 provisional-acceptance-request cutoff. Embassy initial deadlines varied by nationality.
Standing university-nomination advice says admission papers by end September, but 2027 availability requires
confirmation because the general scheme is being discontinued elsewhere. Fellowship nomination deadline not
public.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM April 2027: application and essays accepted December 15,
2026-January 6, 2027, 15:00 JST; no late submissions. This is a separate programme selection for eligible April
2027 UTokyo entrants, not a reopened mathematics admission round.
Additional programme-specific evidence [P]: WINGS-FMSP latest located application window was July 6-10,
2026 (Japanese page: 00:00-24:00), for April/September/October 2026 master's entrants. Applicant and
supervisor documents both due then. 2027 window remains unpublished/unverified. [s1] [s6] [s11] [js14t] [js20t]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Overseas special route: sealed letters accompany the postal application by its September deadline; no later
grace period published. Regular master’s checklist does not list ordinary academic recommendation letters.
MEXT letter accompanies the embassy packet by the nationality-specific embassy deadline.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM: supervisor opinion due January 8, 2027, 15:00 JST; opens
December 15, 2026. [s1] [s3] [s6] [js14t]
Test-score receipt [2027 confirmed]
Regular selection administers its own English examination during 24-25 August 2026; no GRE/TOEFL delivery
deadline in that checklist. Overseas special selection includes language certificates if available with the
application; minimum scores and late-report policy not established. [s1] [s3]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Regular application uploads and fee due 7 July 2026 15:00; exams 24-25 August, oral 27-28 August, final result
8 September 2026. Original academic certificates required at enrollment. Equivalency-only review applications:
11-15 May 2026, registered-mail postmark by 15 May; ordinary UChicago bachelor’s route does not use that
review. [s3]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Enrollment instructions are sent in late February 2027; a public universal reply/payment deadline was not
found. Follow the actual offer and enrollment notice. Special-selection confirmation deadline must be obtained
from liaison. No US April 15 assumption.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM decisions March 8, 2027, approximately 13:00; enrollment
documents due March 15, 2027.
Additional programme-specific evidence [P]: WINGS-FMSP 2026 decisions August 27 around 13:00; enrollment
documents due September 3, 2026, 13:00. These are prior-cycle dates, not 2027 commitments. [s3] [s1] [js15t]
[js20t]

English requirement [Standing rule]
Regular admission tests English itself. Special selection requests Japanese/English proficiency evidence if any
and includes an online examination. The liaison explains that Japanese is not required on arrival but seminar
discussions commonly use it; English competence is indispensable. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
No explicit UChicago/US-degree waiver of the regular English entrance examination or blanket special-route
language certification waiver found. Do not import rules from Tokyo’s separate School of Science/GSGC. [s1] [s3]

Neither GRE appears in the regular Math master’s checklist or overseas-special document list. This establishes

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Overseas special selection: at least two sealed recommendations, including the applicant’s supervisor. Regular
master’s route has no ordinary academic recommendation in its public checklist; foreign-university applicants
do have separate Japanese-ability certification requirements. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Conflict]
MEXT embassy: recommendation from president/dean or academic adviser; an employer letter additionally
applies if employed. Suggested template asks about relationship, growth areas, teamwork, leadership,
confidence, character and potential. Standing Tokyo university-nomination route additionally requests a
dean-or-higher recommendation to the university president; confirm whether that route survives for 2027.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM requires one separate online supervisor opinion; use the
prospective master's supervisor, or undergraduate supervisor if the former is undecided. Exact rating
questions/limits remain unverified: public image-only sample
https://www.s.u-tokyo.ac.jp/ja/FoPM/application/files/Sample_Opinion_202010.pdf.
Additional programme-specific evidence [P]: WINGS-FMSP needs one separate expected-supervisor opinion,
emailed directly to fmsp-group@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp with applicant name in the subject. Form prompt:
“Assessment of research ability and aptitude for the course of applicant”. Use the one-page form unchanged;
discuss doctoral intent and career plans with the applicant. [s6] [s8] [s1] [s11] [js15t] [js22t]

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Special selection uses sealed letters rather than an advertised automated referee invitation. MEXT sample
directs the referee to return a signed, sealed envelope to the applicant for the embassy packet. No portal
invitation trigger is established.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM: entering referee details alone does not invite; automatic
invitation follows applicant submission.
Additional programme-specific evidence [P]: WINGS-FMSP uses direct email attachments rather than
portal-generated invitations. Applicant sends application; supervisor separately sends opinion. Consult the
supervisor before applying. [s1] [s8] [js14t] [js20t]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No evidence of after-submit invitations; collect special-selection and embassy-MEXT recommendations before
submitting those packets. Regular master’s has no ordinary referee workflow in the checklist.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM invitation is sent only after submitting. Submit early enough
for the January 8 deadline. [s1] [s3] [s8] [js14t]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
No individual-letter receipt dashboard confirmed for special selection. Regular exam tickets are emailed from
22 July 2026; contact the office if missing by 29 July. That is not proof of individual reference receipt.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM emails the applicant automatically when the supervisor
submits.
Additional programme-specific evidence [P]: WINGS-FMSP Japanese instructions promise acknowledgment
within two days; contact the office if none arrives. Acceptance of the application requires both documents. [s1]
[s3] [js15t] [js20t]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Regular application contents cannot be changed after completion. No special-route permission for
replacing/reusing letters was found; request a current signed letter and ask liaison about updates. MEXT’s
optional sample is not authorization to reuse a previous-cycle submission.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM prohibits changing a submitted application. Separate
permission to replace/reuse a supervisor opinion was not located. [s3] [s1] [s8] [js15t]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Special selection requires CV information in the requested application form; public page gives no separate
academic-CV length/format. Regular route uses prescribed application/history fields, not a verified standalone
CV upload. [s1] [s5]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Regular questionnaire is the substantive written component; no separate US-style SOP is listed. Special form
includes intended field and research plan; the exact form/prompt/limit must be obtained from liaison before
drafting. [s1] [s4]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
A separate personal/background essay is not specified in the public regular questionnaire or special-selection
list. Permission for an extra upload, prompt and limit are unverified. [s1] [s4]

Research-interest statement [2027 confirmed]
Regular questionnaire requires first and second research fields and an intended-research response of roughly
200 Japanese characters. English is allowed; an English word equivalent is not given. It also asks whether Kavli
IPMU supervision is of interest; the choice is nonbinding. [s2] [s4]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Special-selection form requires a research plan; exact length/format inaccessible without requesting form.
MEXT separately uses a research-plan sheet: paraphrase - past/present study plus proposed Japanese research
theme, plan and goals; maximum two pages, supplementary material allowed, typed/block letters, Japanese if
able. [s1] [s7]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Special selection permits articles list with photocopies as supporting evidence. A bachelor’s thesis upload is not
required by the regular master’s checklist. Doctoral selection instead evaluates a master’s thesis/abstract or
equivalent papers; that is a later degree route. [s1] [s3]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Special route allows a publications list and paper photocopies; no length cap published. Regular master’s
portal’s permission for extra publications or links is unverified. [s1] [s3]
Course-list document [2027 confirmed]
Questionnaire paraphrase: particularly engaging mathematics; senior-seminar/thesis texts with author, title,
publisher, ISBN, coverage and impressions; other advanced texts and mathematical interests. Complete the
prescribed boxes on exactly two A4 pages, PDF upload, Japanese or English. No separate exhaustive
mathematics-course table verified. [s2] [s4]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
Embassy MEXT requires its application, placement choices, research-plan form, medical certificate and
applicable thesis abstracts; English/Japanese documents or translations. Research-plan length/format is in
writing_proposal. Tokyo Fellowship’s current application essays and limits are not public in the checked
material.
Additional programme-specific evidence [U]: FoPM: complete the supplied Application Essays form, convert to
PDF and upload. Current-linked DOCX
https://www.s.u-tokyo.ac.jp/en/FoPM/application/files/FoPM_Essays_24-2.docx was not readable in this research
session; exact prompts, length limits and typography remain unresolved. The filename's 24 does not by itself
invalidate the currently linked template.
Additional programme-specific evidence [P]: WINGS-FMSP 2026 form: (1) personal history of
studies/research/activities, emphasizing initiative and ability; (2) motivation, post-PhD career,
cross-field/cultural cooperation and societal contribution; (3) graduate research goals/methods/scope. Each
occupies one prescribed page, minimum 10-point font, figures allowed; no layout change or extra pages. (4)
research background may expand and requires numbered lists of personally delivered presentations,
publications/preprints and awards; distinguish oral/poster and reviewed/unreviewed items. Give
bibliographic/presentation details; attach acceptance evidence for forthcoming accepted work; report absent
categories explicitly. First page records education, citizenship, existing scholarships, TRA preference, research
topic and three secondary-supervisor choices. Exact complete prompts remain available in the linked form. [s6]
[s7] [s10] [js15t] [js21t]
Other short answers / materials [2027 confirmed]
Regular: current photograph, payment proof and questionnaire. Foreign-university applicants must submit
certification from a supervisor/equivalent concerning Japanese ability; clarify acceptable UChicago
certifier/content with the office. Special form also contains desired-adviser names and pledge. [s3] [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
No guaranteed departmental annual package found. MEXT 2027: master’s JPY 144,000/month; doctorate JPY
145,000/month; nondegree/preparatory JPY 143,000/month, plus applicable regional supplement.
Twelve-month arithmetic: JPY 1,728,000 / 1,740,000 / 1,716,000 before supplements. Tuition/exam/admission
charges waived for qualifying awardees, with conditional travel. Tokyo Fellowship standing amount: JPY
200,000/month; Math nomination highly limited.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM master's TRA begins October 1, 2027 after progress
screening: JPY170,000/month. Thus October-March arithmetic is JPY1,020,000, rather than twelve funded
months from April. Later twelve-month arithmetic is JPY2,040,000. Doctoral TRA is JPY180,000/month
(JPY2,160,000 for twelve months). Competitive appointments, not universal mathematics guarantees.
Additional programme-specific evidence [G]: WINGS-FMSP standing schedule: master's year1
JPY120,000/month for October-March (six-month arithmetic JPY720,000); year2 JPY150,000/month for
April-March (JPY1,800,000), after March review. Doctoral students selected in 2026 or later: TRA
JPY180,000/month, maximum three years. The older JPY200,000 doctoral stipend applies to cohorts selected in

student at most one year. Neither is an automatic admission entitlement.

summer 2031. [s6] [s10] [js15t]

MEXT is for eligible non-Japanese citizens; 2027 general birth cutoff 2 April 1992, with narrow
country-circumstance exceptions. Apply through the Japanese diplomatic mission of chosen eligible nationality.
F-1 alone does not establish nationality eligibility. Tokyo Fellowship targets international graduate students.

intent. April 2027 enrollment precedes June 2027 UChicago graduation. October FoPM recruitment does not
establish October mathematics-degree admission. [s6] [s10] [js15t] [js17t]

MEXT requires appropriate Japanese Student status, progress/attendance and compliance with
combined-award rules; fees/travel depend on award conditions. Tokyo Math says it nominates one outstanding
new self-financed international student for Tokyo Fellowship; selection and exact 2027 compatibility rules
require confirmation.

external-funding applications, JSPS application where applicable, overseas experience and programme notation
on the PhD diploma. Planning industry employment immediately after the master's disqualifies this route.
Requirements include eight credits, diversity/ethics training, career seminar, overseas joint
research/internship, secondary supervision, rotation and seminars.
Additional programme-specific evidence [G]: FoPM TRA cannot be combined with JSPS Fellowship, MEXT or
another UTokyo scholarship. Students may remain FoPM members without its stipend. Another RA position is
prohibited; TA work is permitted. Salary is taxable.

final reports; income tax is withheld. Successful JSPS DC1/DC2 recipients cease receiving this support.

period (twelve-month arithmetic JPY2,400,000); central support page disallows concurrent tuition waivers and
other scholarships. Mathematics nominates one new student; nomination is not an award guarantee, and 2027
department deadline is unresolved. [s6] [s1] [js17t] [js18t] [js16t] [js19t] [js25t]

Liaison identifies private scholarships mainly after arrival; do not budget them as guaranteed pre-entry

checked against the specific offer. [s1] [s9]

tuition: master’s JPY 535,800; doctoral JPY 520,800 (different amounts, not a typo). Charges can change. [s1]

University of Tokyo
Japan · Graduate School of Mathematical Sciences: master’s, then doctoral program; overseas special selection and regular
selection
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• This is the Graduate School of Mathematical Sciences, not the separate School of Science GSGC.
• April intake and closed 2027 deadlines make a June 2027 bachelor’s graduation a significant obstacle; do not
extrapolate deadlines.
• No guaranteed stipend established; scholarships require separate competitive selection.
• FoPM funding selection does not reopen the closed April 2027 mathematics entrance round. Verify
degree-completion and enrollment timing before investing in scholarship essays.
• Central MEXT instructions ask embassy applicants to contact UTokyo only after primary screening via official
contact points; Mathematics liaison expressly accepts earlier special-selection applications. Clarify the
distinction with the liaison, not unsolicited faculty outreach.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
A UChicago bachelor’s normally qualifies for master’s study, not automatic direct doctoral entry. Regular April
2027 applicants must finish by 31 March 2027; a June 2027 conferral misses that intake. Overseas special
selection is for applicants living outside Japan. US F-1 is not Japanese student status; nationality and
graduation date remain essential checks. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Choose regular versus overseas special selection; do not combine them for one academic year. For special
selection request the nonpublic form from liaison@ms.u-tokyo.ac.jp and identify desired supervisors. Regular
2027 faculty enquiries were restricted to before the application period: by 29 June 2026. Normal bachelor’s
eligibility does not require the special equivalency-review route. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Overseas special form names potential supervisors. For the closed regular 2027 round, faculty admissions
enquiries were allowed only through 29 June 2026. Ask liaison about future routes before approaching faculty.
Kavli IPMU advisers involve the Kashiwa affiliation and relevant supervision arrangement. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Regular route online PDF uploads; instructions and questionnaire publicly available, form preview partly
unreadable in text extraction. Special selection is document/postal plus online examination, form by liaison
request; do not assume a US-style application portal. [s1] [s2] [s5]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
April 2027 regular round is closed. Standing overseas-special September deadline has also passed for 2027 as
interpreted from the school’s rule. October entry is exceptional, particularly government scholarship routes; no
fresh 2027 late-opening window verified. June 2027 UChicago graduation is incompatible with April 2027
matriculation. [s1] [s2] [s3]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Regular April 2027: 30 June 2026 10:00-7 July 2026 15:00, now closed (Japan local time inferred from Japanese
instructions). Overseas special route: postal submission by 30 September preceding enrollment year under
standing guidance, hence 30 September 2026 for 2027 as an inference; that date has passed. Ask liaison
whether any later/October 2027 route remains; none verified. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Funding consideration [Conflict]
Tokyo Math’s 2027 embassy-MEXT school deadline was 27 July 2026, earlier than the central MEXT 1
September 2026 provisional-acceptance-request cutoff. Embassy initial deadlines varied by nationality.
Standing university-nomination advice says admission papers by end September, but 2027 availability requires
confirmation because the general scheme is being discontinued elsewhere. Fellowship nomination deadline not
public.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM April 2027: application and essays accepted December 15,
2026-January 6, 2027, 15:00 JST; no late submissions. This is a separate programme selection for eligible April
2027 UTokyo entrants, not a reopened mathematics admission round.
Additional programme-specific evidence [P]: WINGS-FMSP latest located application window was July 6-10,
2026 (Japanese page: 00:00-24:00), for April/September/October 2026 master's entrants. Applicant and
supervisor documents both due then. 2027 window remains unpublished/unverified. [s1] [s6] [s11] [js14t] [js20t]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Overseas special route: sealed letters accompany the postal application by its September deadline; no later
grace period published. Regular master’s checklist does not list ordinary academic recommendation letters.
MEXT letter accompanies the embassy packet by the nationality-specific embassy deadline.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: FoPM: supervisor opinion due January 8, 2027, 15:00 JST; opens
December 15, 2026. [s1] [s3] [s6] [js14t]
Test-score receipt [2027 confirmed]
Regular selection administers its own English examination during 24-25 August 2026; no GRE/TOEFL delivery
deadline in that checklist. Overseas special selection includes language certificates if available with the
application; minimum scores and late-report policy not established. [s1] [s3]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Regular application uploads and fee due 7 July 2026 15:00; exams 24-25 August, oral 27-28 August, final result
8 September 2026. Original academic certificates required at enrollment. Equivalency-only review applications:
11-15 May 2026, registered-mail postmark by 15 May; ordinary UChicago bachelor’s route does not use that
